scope: Coverage-only inventory of the three current conjecture arithmetic reader PDFs against finite Komorebi runtime machinery. Source result extraction and API/test-link verification, not a proof audit, paper-program replay or conjecture closure.

sources.title: The abc Conjecture: Radical Support, Prime Contact, and the Global Bridge
sources.author: Komorebi P.

mechanisms.summary: Primitive a+b=c, radical R=rad(abc), repeated-power part Q=abc/R and the corrected global contact normalization.
boundaries: The relevant defect is Q/(ab)=c/R; a uniform bound Q=R^o(1) is not the source target and is false in general.
Polynomial abc and conditional arithmetic consequences are source results, not integer abc proof certificates emitted by the library.

mechanisms.summary: Prime-coordinate differential, additive row, arithmetic Wronskian, radical divisibility and the three-sector master height inequality.
boundaries: Exact rational valuations are available, but no constructor builds these abc prime-coordinate rows, Wronskians or height witnesses.
A valuation test does not certify the paper-specific divisibility or uniform height estimate.

mechanisms.summary: Valuation words, finite polyphase refinements, first- and second-order phase data, and local lift gauges.
boundaries: These APIs provide supplied finite sequences, capped residue arithmetic and exact one-digit polynomial lift fibers.
They do not construct the abc valuation-word tree, phase-energy invariant or the stated arithmetic gauge from a,b,c.

mechanisms.summary: Two-row obstruction complex, exact lattice extension, stable real-height shell geometry and integral boundary.
boundaries: Finite complexes and supplied lattice/cokernel computations exist; no abc arithmetic assignment or shell-deformation specialization is shipped.
Exact rational or symbolic linear algebra does not alone give the arithmetic integral boundary.

mechanisms.summary: Obstruction cosets, aggregate affine line, CRT normal form and a finite moving-interval search with arbitrary-precision correction.
boundaries: Exact CRT and Smith congruence solvers accept user-supplied finite data; the abc moving-interval search, stopping theorem and source-specific correction routine are not named APIs.
No uniform radical bound follows from a successful finite congruence search.

mechanisms.summary: Prime-shell signal, three-spike p-adic coherence, nonlinear Frey transform, automorphic channel and Landen analysis/synthesis.
boundaries: No runtime constructor supplies the Frey curve, associated automorphic representation or arithmetic channel from a primitive triple.
Generic signal transforms cannot supply those arithmetic identifications; the source itself separates unitary no-saving identities from an arithmetic estimate.

mechanisms.summary: Exact order-divisor packets, quality imbalance, Tate depth, Atkin-Lehner Walsh packets and same-sign separation.
boundaries: Finite divisor transforms and supplied packet operators are generic exact interfaces.
They do not construct Tate periods, Hecke eigenpackets or the Atkin-Lehner decomposition of the abc-associated arithmetic object.

mechanisms.summary: Congruence denominators of integral projectors, toy Hecke orders, cotangent multiplicity and Wiles defect.
boundaries: The paper-specific integral Hecke order, deformation-ring comparison and Wiles-defect calculation are not installed constructors.
A rational projector or generic Smith decomposition does not identify an integral Hecke order or establish complete intersection.

mechanisms.summary: Filtered cusp contact, exact cyclic transducer and Witt-carry realization.
boundaries: No abc cyclic transducer, Witt-vector realization or filtered cusp-contact API is present.
The stated local carry structure does not by itself provide the local-to-global arithmetic bound.

mechanisms.summary: Global Kummer class, contact modulus, Fermat character packet and line-bundle cost.
boundaries: No global cohomology class or Fermat-character packet is constructed by these arithmetic finite interfaces.
Generating-function Kummer terminology is a different contract and does not implement this global construction.

mechanisms.summary: Polylogarithmic distribution, functional closure, archimedean envelope, finite-place notch and a conditional motivic path packet.
boundaries: No three-point motivic path packet or all-place comparison interface is shipped.
Formal identities and conditional motivic hypotheses in the source are not authenticated arithmetic witnesses in the runtime.

mechanisms.summary: Odd-prime log rows, weighted dyadic row, sequential powerful part and coherence regulator.
boundaries: There is no named constructor for the paper-specific cross-prime logarithmic coherence regulator.
Local valuation primitives do not create a global uniform coherence estimate.

mechanisms.summary: Signed arithmetic COS, sparse transverse energy, innovation rank and target polynomial filters.
boundaries: Supplied signed mass and exact finite matrix rank are available; arithmetic COS assignment, Galois coordinates and sparse spectral filters are not.
Finite rank or support results do not establish a prime-uniform innovation or contact bound.

mechanisms.summary: Universal mixed-weight polylog filter from X times the product of (jX-1), coefficient cancellation and depleted local series.
boundaries: No named builder returns the paper coefficients c_(m,s), mixed polylog combination or its exact formal cancellation certificate.
General nonlinear Taylor jets are not this mixed-weight polylogarithmic construction.

mechanisms.summary: Polylog Hankel determinant, formal Cauchy-Binet moment directions, real positivity and complex-branch boundary.
boundaries: Exact rational determinants and finite formal series are primitives; no polylog Hankel determinant or Cauchy-Binet witness builder is installed.
Numerical signal Hankel matrices do not certify this determinant; evaluating a polylog at a rational argument does not automatically make it algebraic.
The real positivity/rank result has the source real-domain hypotheses and does not extend automatically to complex branches.

mechanisms.summary: p-depleted polylog determinants, balanced residue energy and exact determinant-valuation/denominator budgets.
boundaries: These valuation primitives do not construct the p-unit order list, balanced residue energy E_(p,r), depleted determinant or its exact valuation certificate.
The source local valuation results do not supply the absent all-place arithmetic comparison.

mechanisms.summary: Integral rational truncation and the explicit failure of its output-contact requirement at primes greater than the cutoff dividing c.
boundaries: The paper-specific integral truncation and failure checks are not installed or replayed here.
For the stated coprime inputs the proposed W is not divisible by such a prime; this negative control cannot be promoted to a global contact witness.

mechanisms.summary: Conditional nonzero integral witness W_r with Q^s_r divisibility and corrected size bound involving (ab)^s_r.
boundaries: The source leaves the nonzero integral witness and its global realization/height comparison unproved.
The (ab)^s_r factor is necessary; the hypotheses imply abc only if actually established with E_r/s_r tending to zero.
No bounded determinant or local certificate closes this global bridge.

mechanisms.summary: Finite evidence, formal layer and source-specific reproducibility contracts.
boundaries: This audit identifies the current source and runtime interfaces; it does not execute the paper-owned programs or build the source formal layer.
Reported finite ranges remain source evidence, not a fresh runtime stress suite or uniform proof.

mechanisms.summary: Primitive power equations, signature retention, rational parametrization, integral defect and conditional abc ceilings.
boundaries: The paper retains a specific difficult signature; the library has no general Beal solver.
A conditional abc height ceiling or a parametrized family is not an unconditional nonexistence result across signatures.

mechanisms.summary: Complete local squareclass coefficient tests, odd-prime lifting and dyadic criteria with locally surviving families.
boundaries: Finite polynomial lift fibers are available for supplied systems with explicit caps.
No complete Beal squareclass-stratum classifier, dyadic criterion or saturation-family constructor is shipped.
Local survival is not an integer solution or global obstruction.

mechanisms.summary: Genus-two curve retaining exponent data, characteristic-seven cancellation, irreducibility, point counts and modular labels.
boundaries: No named engine constructs the source curve, point-count polynomial or labelled residual modular data from a primitive power equation.
Generic finite-image or spectral infrastructure does not supply this arithmetic curve-to-representation identification.

mechanisms.summary: Natural lattice, opposite extension depth, stable segment, local cup endpoint and global coefficient/Frobenius precision.
boundaries: Supplied finite lattice splitting and exact Smith precision data are available.
No source natural Galois lattice, diagonal characters, extension class or Frobenius values are constructed.

mechanisms.summary: Marked periods, local torsion criterion, twisted reciprocity, conductor-pattern sieve, coupled adjoint equations and mixed traces.
boundaries: The paper-specific finite computations and arithmetic inputs are not installed as one Beal pipeline.
The eight pattern cover is confined to its declared conductor range; homogeneous saturation, local matching and synthetic trace products are not actual Frey representations.

mechanisms.summary: Integral semilinearity, cup vanishing, secondary obstruction, local matching, restricted stages and bare primitives.
boundaries: No named constructor computes these source Galois cochains, bare primitive or secondary integral lift.
An unlabelled local image or fixed synthetic primitive does not authenticate the arithmetic origin.

mechanisms.summary: F49-basis arithmetic, fifteen-row localization map, finite pattern matrices and target evaluator.
boundaries: The source evaluator uses F49 encoding a+7b for a+bw and pattern-specific 15-by-10 matrices; it is not a packaged Komorebi API.
The generic exact rational/symbolic solver is not a substitute for F49 field operations or basis encoding.
No source evaluator replay or source formal build was performed by this coverage audit.

mechanisms.summary: Canonical obstruction class of t(p0) with a full left-null matrix N; Stage P requires N t(p0)=0.
boundaries: The exact backend solves supplied finite cokernel problems over its own rational/symbolic domain.
It does not implement the paper-specific F49 15-by-10 map or construct t(p0).
Homogeneous rank, image and kernel do not determine the arithmetic affine target.

mechanisms.summary: Authenticated fifteen-coordinate localization target from an actual Galois bare primitive, rather than user-supplied or synthetic data.
boundaries: The current source explicitly has no authenticated t(p0) or N t(p0) for any of the eight patterns.
The source finite evaluator reports arithmetic target authentication false; origin-change tests do not repair this missing input.
A finite correction for supplied coordinates is not proof that a primitive power equation realizes those coordinates.

mechanisms.summary: Upper q-stage, integral lifts, unrestricted support/depth and other signatures after a genuinely arithmetic Stage P input.
boundaries: These downstream arithmetic and global obligations remain even if one fixed finite affine test passes.
The source reported finite field, rank-minor, residue-symbol and Frobenius identity ranges are bounded evidence, not Beal nonexistence across all signatures.

mechanisms.summary: Exact finite coefficients of Delta/q by the Euler-product log-derivative recurrence with constant exponent minus 24.
boundaries: Call euler_product_function with c_m=-24 because its convention is product (1-z^m)^(-c_m).
Degree d returns tau(1) through tau(d+1); the leading q of Delta must be restored.
This is a generic finite coefficient construction, not a named tau API or a nonvanishing theorem; existing Euler-product tests are generic.

mechanisms.summary: Independent Jacobi/Eisenstein engines, differential residuals, divisor convolution, Niebur ring and Hurwitz trace/Catalan moment inversion.
boundaries: No dedicated tau Jacobi, Eisenstein, Niebur or Hurwitz-trace engine is installed.
The source cross-checks are not equivalent to the package generic Euler-product test and were not replayed here.

mechanisms.summary: Hecke second-order prime-power recurrence, characteristic roots, local valuation behavior and odd primitive zero-equivalence.
boundaries: The recurrence machinery accepts supplied coefficients and seeds; it does not prove they arise from Delta or construct the attached global Galois representation.
Using supplied tau(p) and p^11 gives finite recurrence values, but the source prime reduction and primitive-content identifications are external mathematical inputs.

mechanisms.summary: Complete V-coded five-core shell enumeration, Vandermonde/288 weights, integral signs and prime-index unit weights.
boundaries: No constructor enumerates v_i congruent to i modulo 5 with zero sum and squared norm 10n, or returns the exact Vandermonde shell weights.
Generic packet containers do not ensure the shell is complete or arithmetic weights are correct.
The source prime-unit property is termwise; opposite signs can cancel.

mechanisms.summary: Degree-at-most-ten shell polynomial P_n, 5-adic content normalization G_n and simple/double local branch counterexamples.
boundaries: The generic polynomial and lift interfaces can analyze supplied integer coefficients; they do not enumerate the shell or build P_n and G_n.
The source simple root at shell 499 and nonlifting double root at 16249 are not package fixtures.
A fixed shell polynomial does not interpolate prime index; valuation formulas permit exact zero.

mechanisms.summary: Harmonic theta packets, power-sum Laplacian, universal symmetric null polynomials, valence and finite stored corrections.
boundaries: No harmonic-theta or symmetric power-sum Laplacian constructor certifies the source universal null family.
Interpolating a finite coefficient range is not universal modular nullness.
The modularity/valence contract and content-conservation theorem remain source results rather than runtime proofs.

mechanisms.summary: Finite sign certificates, dyadic mixed-sign threshold and strict localization boundaries.
boundaries: These finite signed-packet interfaces operate on supplied mass and support; no arithmetic shell sign-certificate search is installed.
Finite support or mixed-sign checks do not prove eventual prime-index positivity; source automatic-valuation and nonintegral-interpolation failures must be retained.

mechanisms.summary: Primitive content, gcd and Mobius inversion, composite obstructions, odd-prime zero equivalence and conservation under all finite symmetric homogeneous nulls.
boundaries: There is no source primitive-content R(n), complete shell Mobius decomposition or universal content-preservation certificate API.
Generic divisor transforms cannot provide the arithmetic shell decomposition or exclude a primitive exact zero.

mechanisms.summary: Exact shell transfers, cancellation localization, zero-total orbit space and degree-dependent rank data at n=31.
boundaries: Exact finite supplied-matrix rank and transfer infrastructure exists; the stored source shell null families and n=31 rank matrices are not shipped.
Ranks at degrees 14, 20 and 22 and the nonzero stored tau(31) survivor do not establish nonzero survivors for every prime.

mechanisms.summary: Fixed congruence-modulus actual prime survivors, integral representations and the Chebotarev quantifier boundary.
boundaries: No arithmetic Delta image or Chebotarev prime-survivor constructor is installed.
Even source actual survivors for each fixed modulus do not yield one adaptive residue/sign certificate for every prime.

mechanisms.summary: Locally compatible trace-zero weakly admissible/crystalline data and a retained-premise global arithmetic countermodel.
boundaries: The paper-specific models are not installed or replayed here.
A compatible local crystalline model is not an actual global Delta Frobenius, and the countermodel is not a zero of the actual tau sequence.

mechanisms.summary: Exact workbook and bounded CRT/NTT modular coefficient engine with explicit inner-convolution reconstruction bounds.
boundaries: No dedicated tau CRT/NTT engine or stored workbook is packaged.
The source modular engine is restricted to the stated modulus and reconstruction bounds; a generic numerical FFT does not provide those exact guarantees.
Source-reported coefficient, shell and local-model ranges were not replayed in this coverage pass.

mechanisms.summary: Remaining actual-Delta nonvanishing at every prime p congruent to 4 modulo 5, with conditional adaptive residue/sign closure.
boundaries: This source concerns Ramanujan tau nonvanishing, not the different Mahler-measure Lehmer conjecture.
The current source leaves the remaining prime family open; no all-prime runtime certificate or recovered compiled Lehmer Lean proof is present.
No finite coefficient range, homogeneous rank result or local trace model proves the remaining nonvanishing assertion.
